qualifying_updates.title: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Meta describes separating a deterministic orchestration layer from 14 specialist agents. Its router follows a fixed protocol for instructions, duplicate checks, required fields, discovery, reliability gates, delegation, and outcome handling; specialists load narrowly scoped knowledge files on demand.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Keep routing, preconditions, and reliability checks deterministic, and give subagents bounded domain context. Version reusable workflow templates and instruction files separately from the router so a new workflow does not require broadening every agent's context.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Normal ingest may extract a local thin-orchestrator checklist; retain Meta-specific system scale and implementation facts upstream.

qualifying_updates.title: A pragmatic guide to AI-assisted development
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Thoughtbot documents a workflow that first makes a project runnable, captures that setup as a reusable skill, loads an issue into a fresh session without immediately implementing it, reproduces the behavior locally, and traces behavior before changing code.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat a repeatable local-run path as a prerequisite for agent verification. Separate issue understanding and reproduction from implementation, and preserve successful environment-discovery work as durable, repository-scoped instructions.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Ingest only the general run-reproduce-trace workflow; do not duplicate product-specific behavior.

qualifying_updates.title: AI Code Review Agents: Teaching AI to Finish Its Work
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Icalia Labs describes a seven-step agent workflow: write a plan, independently challenge it, obtain human approval, implement in parallel, run basic build/test/style gates, use an outside model for adversarial review, then repair and repeat until no serious issue remains.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Do not let the implementation agent be the final judge. Define a severity stop rule, run deterministic gates before review, and return findings to the verification gate after each repair rather than treating a single review pass as completion.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Assess the public dev-loop repository before adopting any specific benchmark figures; the durable local candidate is the independent-review and stop-rule pattern.

qualifying_updates.title: Developer's guide to implementing MCP apps in Gemini
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Google Cloud describes an MCP App deployment with a sandboxed UI, private service ingress, workforce OAuth, a separate in-application OAuth layer, least-privilege outbound service identity, and expert approval before high-stakes actions. Imported actions are disabled until explicitly enabled.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: For governed tool integrations, treat service authentication, end-user authorization, tool enablement, and high-impact approval as distinct controls. Default newly discovered actions to disabled and verify identity boundaries independently of UI sandboxing.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Keep platform configuration and MCP App specification coverage upstream; ingest only the control-separation checklist if needed.

qualifying_updates.title: What scopes should a security MCP connector ask for?
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Safeguard recommends beginning MCP security connectors with project-limited read scopes, using incremental elevation for deeper reads or writes, recording which scope authorized each action, reviewing elevation events, and treating scope changes after vendor updates as a new review event.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Represent agent-access permissions as a task and project-scoped ladder, not a one-time broad grant. Require named approvers and sandboxed trials for write elevation, retain grant and elevation evidence, and review scope drift during connector updates.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Treat the article's ladder as an example rather than a standard; compare any local policy to the authoritative MCP authorization and security guidance during ingest.
